what: This repo's own gate, the cost tiering targets — the fixture's whole suite costs ~0.1 s, this one 220 s

full_gate.command: npm run -s typecheck && npx vitest run --project unit && cargo test -q --workspace
full_gate.source: every verification_recorded of that command in .sofar/initiatives/*/events.jsonl

closing_sweep_repeats.same_tree: 14 runs of the full gate on one tree (1c4df7d) at the sweep, ~260 s each; a tiered run runs it once there

quick_tier.command: npm run -s typecheck && npx vitest related --run --project unit {files}
quick_tier.recommended: add --passWithNoTests, so a task that changed no module (a Rust-only task) passes the quick tier and leaves cargo to the full gate

samples.files: drive-lanes 2.4's commit 3667a3f3: drive.ts, lanes.ts, progress-judge.ts, drive-lanes.test.ts, events.ts, SPEC.md, ARCHITECTURE.md

projection_per_task: 220.7 s → 28-51 s (-77% to -87%); cargo moves to the phase-end full gate. A schema change (events.ts) reaches 203 of the unit files, so its quick tier is most of the suite.
